security_audit.summary: I found no malicious intent, prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or unauthorized network behavior in the reviewed files. Most static findings are false positives from CSV examples, documentation URLs, markdown code fences, and framework guidance. One confirmed issue remains: SKILL.md includes a sudo package installation command, which is unsafe for automatic community-skill execution.

remediation.issue: Privileged package installation instruction in SKILL.md
remediation.suggestion: Remove the sudo apt install workflow and direct users to official Python installation documentation, or require explicit user confirmation before any OS package install.

remediation.issue: Executable prerequisite commands in setup guidance
remediation.suggestion: Replace brew, winget, and apt install examples with passive prerequisite text so agents do not auto-install system packages.

content.user_title: Build Polished Interfaces With UI UX Pro Max
content.value_statement: Teams often lose time choosing styles, palettes, typography, and stack patterns for interface work. This skill searches local UI/UX guidance and turns it into practical design direction.
actual_capabilities: Searches bundled CSV guidance for style, product, color, typography, chart, landing, prompt, and UX domains.
Provides stack-specific recommendations for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Nuxt, and Tailwind.
Ranks local records with a Python BM25 search implementation.
Formats concise search results for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
Supplies UI quality checklists for contrast, accessibility, spacing, hover states, and responsive layout.
Includes design prompts and implementation checklists for many visual styles.
limitations: Requires Python to run the local search script.
Results depend on bundled CSV data and may not reflect latest framework changes.
It does not inspect screenshots or measure rendered accessibility automatically.
It can suggest UI direction, but implementation quality depends on the agent applying the guidance.

use_cases.title: Plan a product interface direction
use_cases.description: Choose a visual style, palette, typography direction, and page structure before building a landing page or SaaS screen.

use_cases.title: Review front-end implementation choices
use_cases.description: Check stack-specific guidance for React, Next.js, Vue, Tailwind, mobile frameworks, and common UI quality issues.

use_cases.title: Standardize team design guidance
use_cases.description: Use searchable local references to keep accessibility, spacing, chart, and typography recommendations consistent across projects.

prompt_templates.title: Find a style direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Use UI UX Pro Max to suggest styles, colors, and typography for a healthcare SaaS landing page.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a landing page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use UI UX Pro Max to plan the sections, CTA strategy, visual style, and accessibility checks for a premium skincare service landing page.

prompt_templates.title: Review an existing interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use UI UX Pro Max to review my dashboard for layout, contrast, typography, chart selection, loading states, and responsive behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Create a stack-specific design plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use UI UX Pro Max to produce a Next.js and Tailwind design plan for a fintech dashboard, including style, typography, charts, and implementation risks.

output_examples.input: Need a polished fintech dashboard direction.
output_examples.output: Recommends a minimal data-dense dashboard, restrained accent colors, clear KPI hierarchy, accessible chart colors, and Next.js performance checks.

output_examples.input: Review this landing page concept for a luxury hotel.
output_examples.output: Highlights a premium editorial style, high-quality imagery, simple booking CTA placement, elegant typography, and mobile spacing checks.

output_examples.input: Choose chart types for product analytics.
output_examples.output: Suggests line charts for trends, funnels for conversion, bar charts for comparison, and notes accessibility requirements for labels and color contrast.

best_practices: Search product, style, typography, color, UX, and stack domains before implementing a full interface.
Treat the results as design guidance, then verify contrast, responsiveness, and accessibility in the rendered UI.
Use stack-specific guidance when the target framework is known.
anti_patterns: Do not copy every suggested style at once; choose a coherent direction for the product context.
Do not treat bundled guidance as a replacement for testing real user flows.
Do not run system installation commands from the skill without explicit user approval.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps choose interface styles, palettes, typography, charts, landing page structure, UX checks, and stack-specific UI guidance.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: The search data is local. Some records include documentation URLs, but the search script reads bundled CSV files.

faq.question: Which stacks are covered?
faq.answer: It includes guidance for HTML and Tailwind, React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, SwiftUI, React Native, and Flutter.

faq.question: Can it build the final interface?
faq.answer: It provides design and implementation guidance. The connected agent still needs to write, test, and verify the final UI.

faq.question: Is it useful for accessibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes accessibility recommendations, but final compliance still requires rendered UI checks and assistive technology testing.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
